entries.description: Single-host blue/green slots keep independent containers, projects, loopback ports, release digests and derived volumes while sharing only controlled state and protecting the active slot.
entries.failClosedRule: The static-governance lane must fail when slots collide, bind publicly, lose durable active state, stop the active slot, bypass capacity checks, accept an unpinned vcpkg or mismatched Node/npm/ReadyToRun image contract, or a failed candidate changes the active runtime.
entries.minimumRequirement: Behavior evidence must cover two concurrent releases, separate probes, idempotent start/stop/status, active-slot recovery, candidate failure containment, port conflict, invalid digest, insufficient resources, compiled ReadyToRun metadata and target-image label plus executable checks.

entries.description: OpenResty keeps one controlled loopback upstream and moves traffic between immutable blue/green releases through validated, fsynced, atomic switch, rollback and restart-recovery transitions.
entries.failClosedRule: The static-governance lane must fail if an unready or mismatched release can receive traffic, a config/reload failure changes the durable active release, concurrent transitions bypass the host lock, public release headers disagree, or recovery guesses an unknown slot.
entries.minimumRequirement: Behavior evidence must cover blue-to-green switch and rollback under sustained requests, exact loopback-only generation, pre/post release probes, staged and active config validation, reload restoration, durable generation commits, lock contention, interrupted-transition diagnosis/recovery and mismatched rollback rejection.

entries.description: Operational templates use one owned ops hierarchy, deployment policy remains under config/deployment, executable workflows remain under tools, and the unsupported historical local proxy cannot return.
entries.failClosedRule: The static-governance lane must reject a top-level deploy root, an unowned ops domain, misplaced Compose/Dockerfile/gateway/policy assets, stale consumers, an unapproved cross-root Compose mount, incomplete ownership or labeling, and either retired local-proxy file.
entries.minimumRequirement: Evidence must cover canonical acceptance plus multi-error rejection fixtures for competing roots, unowned domains, misplaced infrastructure, stale references, cross-root mounts, ownership/label coverage and historical local-proxy retirement.

entries.description: Production release identity binds one commit, immutable registry digest, frontend/Wasm hashes, runtime slot, readiness and release evidence without mutable deployment tags.
entries.failClosedRule: The static-governance lane must reject mutable or inconsistent manifests, pulled image digests or labels, missing production runtime identity, and release evidence that does not match its commit and image digest.
entries.minimumRequirement: Evidence must cover manifest creation and immutability, digest/OCI label verification, no-build deploy dry-run, production startup/readiness identity, and release evidence coherence.

entries.description: Root EditorConfig, Roslyn settings, baseline-aware changed/full checks and reviewed blame metadata enforce the Microsoft .NET C# mother style without rewriting external contracts.
entries.failClosedRule: Fast Static Governance must reject new C# whitespace, brace, using, naming, encoding or scoped XML-documentation drift, stale baseline policy identity, excluded-path leakage, placeholder blame revisions and local/CI diagnostic disagreement.
entries.minimumRequirement: Evidence must cover positive and aggregate negative fixtures, generated exclusions, public-contract XML scope, external naming adapters, changed/full/strict-full modes, formatter idempotence and the exact reviewed mechanical migration SHA.

entries.description: Named .NET/container publish profiles are one-factor comparable, digest-bound to release images and measured across all production route classes on isolated target/load-generator resources.
entries.failClosedRule: The static-governance lane must reject mixed-factor controls, missing profile/OCI/effective-runtime identity, host-only capacity claims, topology placement drift, cross-SHA or cross-hardware evidence, incomplete routes or rounds, unisolated load generation, unreconciled slot/snapshot/SSR memory, invented unavailable counters, startup-only throughput selection, unproven ThreadPool tuning and NativeAOT without feature/security parity.

entries.description: Repository configuration has one canonical owner: generic settings under config, framework tool manifests under .config, and project-specific appsettings or launch profiles colocated with their owning project.
entries.failClosedRule: Reject a competing configs root, unapproved root JSON, ownerless config/development or root Properties content, duplicate or missing canonical ownership, stale solution/project includes, non-colocated launch profiles, old Stryker/SLO/moderation paths or ignored canonical Compose launch settings.
entries.minimumRequirement: Static governance must execute positive and tamper fixtures for the ownership registry, restore the pinned dotnet tools, resolve every moderation/SLO/mutation/development-governance owner, and keep the minimal development example, production env example and Compose launch profile discoverable at canonical paths.
